items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: one name I do remember because I'd read often about him, Dagid Bey

ctx.x: in Turkey, and one name I do remember because I'd read often about him, Dagid Bey, the twelve of them were executed and hanged. They were condemned at 10:00 o'clock in the evening. They were condemned at 9:00 o'clock in the evening, and hanged at 10:00 in the marketplace of Ankara. I'll tell you the rest in a minute. We found that out through our chauffeur, the chauffeur that came to take us back to the hotel. We tried to -- we bribed the chauffeur to take us to the marketplace, because he said that the bodies…
You mean they pulled him out of the car.
